Here’s how you can update your main account details with NOBULL:

Shipping address for a subscription: Log into your account, select Manage Subscription, click Edit next to Shipping Information, update your address, and save.
Payment method for a subscription: Log in, go to Manage Subscription, click Edit next to Billing, and update or add a payment method. You can also set a primary card.
Other subscription details: In My Account > Manage Subscription, you can edit or skip a delivery, pause or cancel your subscription, change delivery frequency, swap an item, or update shipping/payment info. Make changes before your next scheduled shipment.
Email address: Email changes are not supported. NOBULL recommends creating a new account with the correct email address.
